Schnittstelle FiniteStateMachine.MooreMachineBuilder<S,IA,OA>

Typparameter:
S - the type of states
IA - the type of input symbols (Input Alphabet)
OA - the type of output symbols (Output Alphabet)
Alle Superschnittstellen:

Umschließende Klasse:

public static interface FiniteStateMachine.MooreMachineBuilder<S,IA,OA> extends FiniteStateMachine.FiniteStateMachineBuilder<S, IA, OA, FiniteStateMachine.MooreMachineBuilder<S,IA,OA>>

Builder for configuring and creating Moore-type finite state machines.

  • Methodendetails

    • outputFunction

      FiniteStateMachine.MooreMachineBuilder<S,IA,OA> outputFunction(@NonNull org.quurz.foomp.base.core.Fun<S,OA> outputFunction)

      Sets the Moore output function mapping each state to an output symbol.

      Parameter:
      outputFunction - the output function mapping state to output; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      this builder instance for method chaining
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if outputFunction is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • outputFunction

      default FiniteStateMachine.MooreMachineBuilder<S,IA,OA> outputFunction(@NonNull OutputMapping<S,OA>... outputMappings)

      Sets the Moore output function using declarative output mappings.

      Parameter:
      outputMappings - the declarative output mappings from state to output symbol; must not be null or contain null elements
      Gibt zurück:
      this builder instance for method chaining
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if outputMappings is null or contains null elements
      IllegalStateException - if duplicate state mappings are provided
      Seit:
      1.0.0
